ignoreValues.reason: Sidebar hover-expand (.bank-sidebar width, .sidebar-label max-width): element is position:absolute and out of flow, so the animated width doesn't cascade reflow to siblings (.bank-main uses a static margin-left, not tied to sidebar width) - only a handful of nav rows reflow internally. Discrete hover interaction, not scroll/high-frequency. A transform/opacity-only rewrite would need a duplicated flyout or counter-scale trick, not worth the complexity for this contained case.
